render.cameraSurfaceMethod: Native procedural camera-ray radiance, BSDF retained for noncamera transport. No view-specific materials, recoloring or fitting.

materialCoordinateContract.rail: Straight rails use per-object localX signed across the section ±.065 and localZ relative to its center±.095; common field is invariant in the longitudinal direction. Curved family geometry must provide an equivalent native cross-section coordinate basis rather than reuse worldX.
materialCoordinateContract.deck: Source UV.x incoming0→outgoing1; phase -7*i/24; FRACT(7*UV.x+phase); seven periods/cell. UV.y cross-deck remains unchanged.
materialCoordinateContract.wood: Default per-mesh native object coordinates (not original orientation object), so independent module copies have identical procedural grain. Camera radiance varies only with |normal.z| for horizontal light symmetry.

nativeShadingNotes: Camera-ray procedural radiance provides uninterrupted native stylized surface values. It is evaluated in Blender, contains no target image, and retains BSDF for other rays.
